summary.title: Project Next — Threat Model
summary.description: Threat model for Project Next Telegram Bot + LLM + Analytics + Web Admin architecture.

data.name: Internet
data.description: External users and third-party APIs

data.name: K8s namespace dev
data.description: Main application services and stores

data.description: Kafka cluster and answers.received topic

data.description: VictoriaMetrics and vmagent

data.name: Telegram User
data.description: User interacting with the Telegram bot

data.name: User Browser / Admin
data.description: Browser user accessing web-admin

data.name: Telegram Bot API
data.description: External Telegram API used by telegram-api polling loop

data.name: OpenRouter API
data.description: External LLM provider API

data.name: telegram-api :8080
data.description: Receives Telegram messages, publishes events, interacts with Redis, users, web-admin and Vault for secrets

threats.title: Telegram token compromise
threats.description: Compromise of TELEGRAM_TOKEN allows interaction with Telegram Bot API on behalf of the bot.
threats.mitigation: Store TELEGRAM_TOKEN in Vault with least-privilege policy, restrict Vault access, do not log secret values, rotate token.

threats.title: Unauthenticated internal service calls
threats.description: Internal HTTP calls from telegram-api to users, web-admin, Redis and Kafka may lack mTLS or service authentication.
threats.mitigation: Add mTLS or internal service authentication; restrict with NetworkPolicy.

threats.title: Telegram message flood
threats.description: Missing rate limiting on incoming Telegram messages can overload telegram-api, Redis, Kafka and users.
threats.mitigation: Rate limit by chat_id/user_id, add backpressure, resource limits and autoscaling.

data.name: scheduler
data.description: Background scheduler interacting with Redis, users and Vault for TELEGRAM_TOKEN

threats.title: Redis pub/sub tampering
threats.description: Scheduler reads or publishes Redis pub/sub without confirmed authentication.
threats.mitigation: Enable Redis ACL/password, restrict NetworkPolicy, sign critical messages.

threats.title: Scheduler token disclosure
threats.description: Any pod with access to Secret or environment may read TELEGRAM_TOKEN.
threats.mitigation: Restrict Vault policy and service account access, do not log env, rotate tokens and revoke leaked Vault tokens.

data.name: recommender :8080
data.description: Generates recommendations using Redis, users, analytics, OpenRouter and Vault for OPENROUTER_API_KEY

threats.title: OpenRouter key compromise
threats.description: Compromise of OPENROUTER_API_KEY allows use of project LLM quota or funds.
threats.mitigation: Store key in Vault, restrict access by service account, rotate key, configure provider budget and quotas.

threats.title: User data sent to external LLM
threats.description: Recommender sends user data to external OpenRouter API.
threats.mitigation: Anonymize chat_id/user_id, remove PII from prompt, configure retention with provider.

threats.title: LLM latency blocks recommendations
threats.description: OpenRouter or LLM latency can block recommendation processing.
threats.mitigation: Use rate limiter, max concurrency, circuit breaker, timeout and queue backpressure.

data.name: web-admin :8080
data.description: Web administration UI exposed through admin.sparktonapp.ru, uses Vault for SESSION_KEY

threats.title: Admin session spoofing
threats.description: Compromise of SESSION_KEY can allow forged admin sessions.
threats.mitigation: Store SESSION_KEY in Vault, rotate it, use HTTPOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies and short TTL.

threats.title: Admin UI exposed to Internet
threats.description: Ingress admin.sparktonapp.ru exposes web-admin to the Internet.
threats.mitigation: Keep TLS, add HSTS, rate limiting, authentication and audit logging.

threats.title: Cross-user data access
threats.description: web-admin may read analytics or users data without proper authorization checks.
threats.mitigation: Authorize by chat_id/user_id and do not rely only on client-side checks.

data.name: users :8080
data.description: User service, PostgreSQL-backed user data and Vault for database credentials

threats.title: Unauthenticated users API
threats.description: users API is available inside the cluster without confirmed caller authentication.
threats.mitigation: Add internal service authentication or mTLS; restrict callers with NetworkPolicy.

threats.title: Unauthorized CRUD calls
threats.description: Any service in dev namespace may call users CRUD endpoints.
threats.mitigation: Authorize by caller identity, use RBAC/NetworkPolicy and block unnecessary direct access.

threats.title: PostgreSQL emptyDir data loss
threats.description: users depends on PostgreSQL on emptyDir and can lose data when pod is recreated.
threats.mitigation: Use PersistentVolumeClaim, backup/restore and readiness/liveness probes.

data.name: analytics :8080
data.description: Consumes Kafka events and writes analytics to ClickHouse

threats.title: Unverified Kafka event processing
threats.description: Kafka consumer may process unverified events from answers.received.
threats.mitigation: Use Kafka TLS listener 9093, ACLs/SASL and verify producer identity.

threats.title: Metrics endpoint disclosure
threats.description: /metrics is available without authentication and can reveal internal information.
threats.mitigation: Restrict /metrics with NetworkPolicy, add metrics auth and avoid PII in metrics.

threats.title: Excessive analytics access
threats.description: analytics may read or aggregate user data it should not access.
threats.mitigation: Authorize at API level and minimize PII in Kafka and ClickHouse.

data.name: Kafka Cluster
data.description: Kafka broker cluster in namespace kafka

threats.title: Kafka plaintext listener
threats.description: Kafka has plaintext listener 9092 with tls=false.
threats.mitigation: Use TLS listener 9093, disable plaintext listener and enable SASL/ACL.

threats.title: Kafka topic tampering
threats.description: Without ACL any authorized producer/consumer can write or read answers.received.
threats.mitigation: Use Kafka ACLs, separate service accounts and restrict dev access.

threats.title: Kafka availability weakness
threats.description: Kafka replication factor and min.insync.replicas are set to 1.
threats.mitigation: Increase replication factor and min ISR for production and monitor lag.

data.name: VictoriaMetrics / vmagent
data.description: Metrics scraping and storage

threats.title: Metrics information disclosure
threats.description: vmagent scrapes /metrics endpoints in dev and kafka and may collect internal information.
threats.mitigation: Restrict NetworkPolicy, do not emit secrets or PII in metrics, restrict query API access.

threats.title: Scrape load
threats.description: 10s scrape interval can add load to services.
threats.mitigation: Use a reasonable interval, resource limits and monitor scrape errors.

data.name: PostgreSQL :5432
data.description: User database store

threats.title: Postgres secret exposure
threats.description: POSTGRES_PASSWORD is stored in Vault; broad Vault policies or compromised users service can expose it.
threats.mitigation: Restrict Vault policy to users service, use short-lived credentials where possible and rotate credentials.

threats.title: PostgreSQL data loss
threats.description: PostgreSQL uses emptyDir and can lose data when pod is recreated.
threats.mitigation: Use PVC, backup/restore and monitor disk.

data.name: Redis :6379
data.description: Cache and pub/sub store

threats.title: Redis pub/sub tampering
threats.description: Redis pub/sub may be available to any pod inside namespace without ACL/password authentication.
threats.mitigation: Enable Redis ACL/password, separate users/channels and restrict NetworkPolicy.

threats.title: Redis user data disclosure
threats.description: Redis may store temporary user data, sessions or last recommendations.
threats.mitigation: Do not store PII longer than necessary, enable auth and restrict access.

data.name: ClickHouse :9000
data.description: Analytics data store

threats.title: ClickHouse unauthenticated access
threats.description: ClickHouse manifests create no TLS certs and accessManagement is false.
threats.mitigation: Enable TLS, access management, separate users/roles and restrict NetworkPolicy.

threats.title: Analytics data tampering
threats.description: A user with ClickHouse access may modify analytical data.
threats.mitigation: Use RBAC/roles, audit, backups and readonly analytics roles.

data.name: Vault :8200
data.description: Central secret store for service credentials and API keys

threats.title: Vault policy bypass
threats.description: Overly broad Vault policies or Kubernetes service account bindings may let a service read secrets it does not need.
threats.mitigation: Use least-privilege Vault policies, bind secrets to service accounts, audit secret reads and rotate exposed credentials.

threats.title: Vault token leakage
threats.description: Vault tokens or AppRole responses may be exposed through environment variables, logs or pod compromise.
threats.mitigation: Use short TTL tokens, avoid logging Vault responses, inject secrets only into required pods and revoke leaked tokens.

threats.title: Vault availability dependency
threats.description: Services that fetch secrets at startup may fail if Vault is unavailable.
threats.mitigation: Run Vault highly available, cache only necessary secrets with TTL, add readiness checks and secret-refresh fallback.

data.name: Kafka Topic answers.received
data.description: Kafka topic for received answer events

threats.title: Topic event tampering
threats.description: Unauthorized producer may publish or modify events in answers.received.
threats.mitigation: Use producer identity, Kafka ACLs and signed critical events.

data.name: Telegram User to Telegram Bot API
data.description: User sends messages to Telegram Bot API

data.name: Telegram Bot API to telegram-api
data.description: telegram-api polls Telegram Bot API using TELEGRAM_TOKEN

threats.title: Telegram token compromise
threats.description: Compromise of TELEGRAM_TOKEN allows reading or sending messages as the bot.
threats.mitigation: Use Vault for TELEGRAM_TOKEN, restrict Vault policy, rotate token and minimize logging.

threats.title: Token disclosure in transit or logs
threats.description: TELEGRAM_TOKEN may be disclosed if channel or logs are compromised.
threats.mitigation: Use HTTPS only, do not log tokens and rotate on suspicion; protect Vault retrieval path with short TTL.

data.name: telegram-api to Redis
data.description: telegram-api uses Redis for cache/session/state

data.name: telegram-api to users
data.description: telegram-api calls users service

data.name: users to PostgreSQL
data.description: users service reads and writes user data to PostgreSQL store

threats.title: Plaintext PostgreSQL connection
threats.description: users connects to PostgreSQL with sslmode=disable over the network; credentials live in DATABASE_URL / Vault.
threats.mitigation: Enable TLS for PostgreSQL connections (sslmode=require/verify-full) and restrict NetworkPolicy so only users pod can reach :5432.

threats.title: SQL injection via users queries
threats.description: user-controlled data may reach SQL queries if not parameterized, leading to data tampering or exposure.
threats.mitigation: Use parameterized queries / ORM, apply least-privilege DB role and input validation in the users service.

data.name: telegram-api to web-admin
data.description: telegram-api sends data to web-admin

data.name: telegram-api to Kafka topic answers.received
data.description: telegram-api publishes answer events to Kafka

threats.title: Kafka plaintext event transfer
threats.description: User event data is transferred between dev and kafka; plaintext listener 9092 allows interception inside the cluster.
threats.mitigation: Use TLS listener 9093, disable plaintext listener and enable Kafka ACLs/SASL.

threats.title: Kafka event tampering
threats.description: Without ACL a producer/consumer can tamper with or read answers.received.
threats.mitigation: Use Kafka ACLs, separate service accounts and verify producer identity.

data.name: Kafka topic answers.received to analytics
data.description: analytics consumes events from Kafka

threats.title: Unverified Kafka consumer
threats.description: analytics may consume unverified events from answers.received.
threats.mitigation: Use TLS, ACLs/SASL and producer identity checks.

data.name: analytics to ClickHouse
data.description: analytics writes analytics data to ClickHouse

data.name: Vault to telegram-api
data.description: telegram-api retrieves TELEGRAM_TOKEN from Vault at startup or refresh

threats.title: TELEGRAM_TOKEN retrieval compromise
threats.description: TELEGRAM_TOKEN is retrieved from Vault; compromised service account, Vault token or policy can disclose or replay the secret.
threats.mitigation: Bind Vault policy to telegram-api service account, use short TTL credentials, audit reads and rotate token.

data.name: Vault to scheduler
data.description: scheduler retrieves TELEGRAM_TOKEN from Vault for polling or token refresh

threats.title: TELEGRAM_TOKEN retrieval compromise
threats.description: TELEGRAM_TOKEN is retrieved from Vault; compromised service account, Vault token or policy can disclose or replay the secret.
threats.mitigation: Limit scheduler Vault role to TELEGRAM_TOKEN only, use short TTL and revoke leaked Vault tokens.

data.name: Vault to recommender
data.description: recommender retrieves OPENROUTER_API_KEY from Vault before calling OpenRouter

threats.title: OPENROUTER_API_KEY retrieval compromise
threats.description: OPENROUTER_API_KEY is retrieved from Vault; compromised service account, Vault token or policy can disclose or replay the secret.
threats.mitigation: Use least-privilege Vault policy, avoid logging key, enforce provider quotas and rotate key.

data.name: Vault to web-admin
data.description: web-admin retrieves SESSION_KEY from Vault for admin session signing

threats.title: SESSION_KEY retrieval compromise
threats.description: SESSION_KEY is retrieved from Vault; compromised service account, Vault token or policy can disclose or replay the secret.
threats.mitigation: Restrict Vault access to web-admin, rotate SESSION_KEY and enforce short session TTL.

data.name: Vault to users
data.description: users service retrieves PostgreSQL credentials from Vault

threats.title: POSTGRES_PASSWORD retrieval compromise
threats.description: POSTGRES_PASSWORD is retrieved from Vault; compromised service account, Vault token or policy can disclose or replay the secret.
threats.mitigation: Grant users service only DB credential path, prefer short-lived DB credentials and rotate password.

data.name: scheduler to Redis
data.description: scheduler uses Redis for job state

data.name: scheduler to users
data.description: scheduler calls users service

data.name: recommender to Redis
data.description: recommender uses Redis cache and pub/sub

data.name: recommender to users
data.description: recommender reads user context

data.name: recommender to analytics
data.description: recommender reads analytics aggregates

data.name: recommender to OpenRouter API
data.description: recommender sends prompts to OpenRouter

threats.title: OpenRouter API key compromise
threats.description: OPENROUTER_API_KEY in Bearer header can be used if the pod is compromised.
threats.mitigation: Use HTTPS, Vault-managed OPENROUTER_API_KEY, rotation and provider budget/quotas.

threats.title: PII sent to OpenRouter
threats.description: OpenRouter receives chatID and user analytics.
threats.mitigation: Anonymize data before sending and remove PII from prompt.

data.name: User Browser to web-admin
data.description: Admin accesses web-admin through Ingress

threats.title: Admin session spoofing
threats.description: Compromise of SESSION_KEY can allow forged sessions.
threats.mitigation: Use Vault-managed SESSION_KEY, token TTL 15 minutes, session TTL 1 hour, HTTPOnly, Secure, SameSite and rotate SESSION_KEY.

threats.title: Public admin UI exposure
threats.description: Ingress admin.sparktonapp.ru exposes web-admin to Internet.
threats.mitigation: Keep TLS via cert-manager, add HSTS, rate limiting and audit logging.

data.name: web-admin to users
data.description: web-admin calls users service

data.name: web-admin to analytics
data.description: web-admin calls analytics service

data.name: VictoriaMetrics/vmagent to metrics endpoints
data.description: vmagent scrapes /metrics endpoints in dev and kafka

threats.title: Metrics disclosure
threats.description: VictoriaMetrics scrapes /metrics endpoints and metrics may reveal internal information.
threats.mitigation: Do not emit PII or secrets in metrics, restrict query API and use NetworkPolicy.

threats.title: Scrape-induced load
threats.description: 10s scrape interval may add load to services.
threats.mitigation: Use reasonable interval, resource limits and monitor scrape errors.
